const previousSession = String($json.session_id ?? $json.requested_session_id ?? '').trim();
const reason = String($json.compression_error ?? 'Hermes compression failed.').trim();
const originalInput = String($json.input || $json.resume_input || '').trim();

const handoff = [
  'SESSION HANDOFF — continue in a fresh Hermes session.',
  '',
  'The previous Hermes session could not be safely compressed, so continuation was moved to a new session.',
  'Do NOT restart the task from scratch.',
  'Preserve the existing task objective, constraints, progress and expected output format.',
  '',
  'PREVIOUS SESSION ID:',
  previousSession || '(unknown)',
  '',
  'COMPRESSION FAILURE:',
  reason || '(unknown)',
  '',
  'ORIGINAL TASK INPUT:',
  originalInput || '(not available)',
  '',
  'CONTINUE:',
  'Resume the task from the information above. Verify the current repository/workspace state before making changes.'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: {
  ...$json,
  handoff_input: handoff,
  handoff_from_session_id: previousSession,
  compression_handoff: true,
  run_id: '',
  session_id: '',
  requested_session_id: ''
} }];
